subject: Compliance bridgework: ISO scope & FedRAMP readiness questions
messages:
From: Jill Carter <jill.carter@brightlineadvisors.com>
To: hannah_schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.io>
Cc: Tom Reynolds <tom.reynolds@acmebank.com>
Date: 2028-03-08T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Initial questions: evidence window & ISO scope ahead of readiness scan

Hi Hannah,

Thanks for taking this on. Our readiness scan for Acme Bank is scheduled for the week of 2028-04-18; before we kick off we want to confirm a few scoping and evidence questions so we can prepare our intake and reduce friction during the on-site window. High level asks below — please respond with owners and the anticipated delivery cadence where possible.

1) Evidence window for log artifacts and snapshots — FedRAMP baseline typically expects 90 days, but for ISO 27001 internal audit we sometimes accept 30 days. Which window should we plan for across your public cloud, managed services, and any dedicated enclaves?
2) KMS / key rotation proof — do you have a recent rotation record and a KMS attestation we can include in the intake? If rotation is automated, a system log snippet is fine.
3) SIG/CAIQ — do you have an updated CAIQ or a mapping showing which questions are in-scope for Acme Bank? We can pre-load signal control families to speed review.
4) Redaction and PII handling — we need to confirm packet captures and logs can be redacted or delivered in a stubbed format.

Attachments: SIG-CAIQ-request.pdf (the template we will use).

If you can reply with a short mutual action plan this week, we will schedule a 30-minute intake call next week to align owners.

Best,
Jill Carter
Senior Assessor, Brightline Advisors

From: hannah_schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.io>
To: Jill Carter <jill.carter@brightlineadvisors.com>
Cc: Tom Reynolds <tom.reynolds@acmebank.com>, olga_petrov <olga_petrov@redwood.io>, karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.io>
Date: 2028-03-08T10:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Initial questions: evidence window & ISO scope ahead of readiness scan

Hi Jill — thanks, this is helpful and timely. Quick ack and outline of next steps from our side. I copied our controls and infra leads so we can assign owners.

Short answers (subject to confirmation from infra owners):
- Evidence window: target 90 days across public cloud and managed services; dedicated enclave snapshots — we can provide the last 30/90 day snapshots depending on requested depth.
- KMS / key rotation: we maintain a rotation log and use customer-managed KMS for private deployments; will validate attestation availability.
- SIG/CAIQ: we have a current CAIQ export but it needs trimming to the Acme scope. I will attach a working timeline for evidence delivery.
- Redaction: yes, logs can be redacted; we will work with your intake team on acceptable redaction patterns.

I've attached "compliance_timeline_v0.xlsx" — it lists proposed owners and tentative delivery dates. Proposed intake call slots: 2028-03-15 09:00-11:00 PT or 2028-03-16 13:00-15:00 PT (Calendly link in thread).

Next step: Olga and Karthik, can you confirm the log retention windows and whether VM/DB snapshots are extractable as requested? Also Rishi, can you confirm the KMS rotation evidence we can provide and whether we need Legal sign-off for the attestation?

Thanks — Hannah
Hannah Schmitt
Director, Compliance Programs | Redwood Inference

From: olga_petrov <olga_petrov@redwood.io>
To: hannah_schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.io>, karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.io>, rishi_malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.io>
Cc: Jill Carter <jill.carter@brightlineadvisors.com>, Tom Reynolds <tom.reynolds@acmebank.com>
Date: 2028-03-08T11:40:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Initial questions: evidence window & ISO scope ahead of readiness scan

Quick technical notes / owners from infra and control perspective. Quoting Hannah inline for context.

> Evidence window: target 90 days across public cloud and managed services; dedicated enclave snapshots — we can provide the last 30/90 day snapshots depending on requested depth.

Owner: Olga (Infra & Evidence). We keep 90 days of aggregated auth/access logs in ELK for hosted APIs, and 365 days of audit logs in cold storage for Dedicated customers by default. For Private (VPC/on-prem) deployments we can export snapshot digests going back to the last 90 days if we have customer consent. Deliverables we can produce:
- Aggregated auth/access logs (90 days) — CSV export + sampling guidance.
- Snapshot manifest for dedicated pools (dates & hashes) + procedures on how to request a full snapshot if needed.
- For on-prem enclaves, we will provide a redacted vm-snapshot manifest and a process to request sanitized artifacts.

> KMS / key rotation: we maintain a rotation log and use customer-managed KMS for private deployments; will validate attestation availability.

Owner: Rishi (Security Ops). We have a KMS rotation ledger and can export a rotation event log (timestamps, key IDs, operator id). We do not publish private key material. If Brightline needs a formal attestation, Legal will need to sign off on a templated statement. See attached stub: kms_rotation_log_stub.txt (sample rows).

> SIG/CAIQ: we have a current CAIQ export but it needs trimming to the Acme scope.

Owner: Karthik (Control Mapping + CAIQ). I will produce a CAIQ slice showing which questions are relevant for the Acme Bank scope and mark answers that require company-level attestation vs. evidence.

Risks / blockers:
- PII redaction: we need explicit guidance from Acme on fields to redact in logs (IP, email, session ids). Providing raw PCAPs without pre-redaction is a blocker.
- Legal attestation turnaround: expect 3 business days from request to signed template.

I will add proposed artifact names to Hannah's timeline and push a draft Google Drive folder.

— Olga
Olga Petrov
Senior Infrastructure Security Engineer | Redwood Inference

From: karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.io>
To: olga_petrov <olga_petrov@redwood.io>, hannah_schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.io>, rishi_malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.io>
Cc: Jill Carter <jill.carter@brightlineadvisors.com>
Date: 2028-03-09T08:22:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Initial questions: evidence window & ISO scope ahead of readiness scan

Agree with the owners. A few practical clarifications for the CAIQ/SIG intake that will affect deliverable shape:

- FedRAMP baseline expects 90 days of runtime logs and configuration snapshots; for ISO 27001 we can often scope 30-90 days depending on the control. For simplicity, we'll prepare 90 days as primary deliverable and annotate which artifacts are optional for ISO-only reviewers.
- For CAIQ mapping, I'll export Q&A answers and add a column per Acme control that marks whether we have direct artifacts, a narrative, or a policy-only response. This will help the assessor pre-scan.
- Regarding redaction: I recommend a two-stage approach — 1) provide manifests and samples (redacted) to Brightline, 2) if assessor needs deeper samples, request a scoped extraction with Acme legal on the call.

I'll slot time to cut the CAIQ slice on 2028-03-11 and will upload to the drive. Suggest we confirm intake call for 2028-03-15 10:00 PT (Hannah's earlier option).

— Karthik
Karthik Iyer
Controls & Compliance Manager | Redwood Inference

From: hannah_schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.io>

Subject: Re: Initial questions: evidence window & ISO scope ahead of readiness scan

Thanks everyone — below is the mutual action plan we'll use to prepare for the week-of-2028-04-18 readiness scan. I've tried to keep items short and owner-assigned. Please confirm if anything needs to move.

MUTUAL ACTION PLAN (short):
- 2028-03-11: Karthik to upload CAIQ slice (control mapping + evidence flags) to Drive. (Karthik)
- 2028-03-11: Olga to publish log manifest + sample exports for 90-day auth/access logs. (Olga)
- 2028-03-12: Rishi to export KMS rotation event log and prepare an attestation template for Legal. (Rishi)
- 2028-03-15: Intake call (30 min) to align on redaction patterns, final artifact list, and on-site logistics. Proposed: 2028-03-15 10:00 PT. (Hannah leads scheduling)
- 2028-03-22: Final artifact delivery (manifests, samples, CAIQ slice); confirm on-site checklist.

DELIVERABLE FORMAT NOTES:
- All log extracts: CSV with column headers + a separate manifest describing redaction rules.
- Snapshots: file hashes and timestamps in manifest; full artifacts by controlled request only.
- KMS rotation: event log CSV (no key material) + attestation PDF if Legal signs.

ATTACHMENTS / LINKS: compliance_timeline_v0.xlsx, SIG-CAIQ-request.pdf (Jill), Drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1aBcdExampleComplianceFolder

If Acme (Tom) has any constraints or preferred redaction patterns please flag them now so we can codify before the intake call. Jill — does this plan look workable from your team?

Thanks — Hannah
Hannah Schmitt
Director, Compliance Programs | Redwood Inference

From: Jill Carter <jill.carter@brightlineadvisors.com>
To: hannah_schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.io>, olga_petrov <olga_petrov@redwood.io>, karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.io>, rishi_malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.io>

Subject: Re: Initial questions: evidence window & ISO scope ahead of readiness scan

Hi all — this looks great and doable. Confirm intake call 2028-03-15 10:00 PT. For redaction, Acme's legal prefers tokenization of email addresses and session ids; IPs can be shown as /24. We'll share a short pre-read on acceptable stub formats by end of day 2028-03-11.

I'll add the intake call to the calendar and share a pre-read pack (~2 pages) before the call. Looking forward to the CAIQ slice and manifests.

Best,
Jill
